incident_text: Part of a five-storey apartment building has collapsed. Dust covers the street and neighbours say some residents may still be inside.

result.scene_summary: A collapsed multi-story building with debris scattered around, showing significant structural damage. Nearby structures and vegetation are visible in the background.

observations.description: A multi-story building is completely collapsed, with debris covering the ground and partially collapsing walls.
A standing utility pole is visible near the debris.
A tree is visible in the background, along with some bushes and other plants.
Various pieces of wood, metal, and rubble are piled up around the collapsed structure.

not_determinable: water depth or presence of flood_water
